reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Remove deprecated feature gate `ValidateCAA`. Setting this feature gate is now a no-op which does nothing but print a warning log line", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Setting the ValidateCAA feature gate no longer has any effect; it does nothing except print a warning log line.
consequence.remediation: Remove the ValidateCAA feature gate from configuration.

proposed.statement: The deprecated feature gate ValidateCAA is removed; setting it is now a no-op that only prints a warning log line.
